title: Introduction to Public Sector and Public Management

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts and principles of public sector and public management, and apply them to explain public issues.
Analyze public issues and propose appropriate management solutions in the public sector.
Develop skills in presenting and communicating ideas effectively in group settings.
Analyze public issues and make decisions in public management.
Work independently or in groups, evaluate and improve the effectiveness of activities.
Guide and supervise others in completing tasks, take personal and group responsibility.
Identify and solve practical public management issues, defend personal viewpoints.
Act with a spirit of service, social responsibility, and professional ethics.
Engage in continuous learning to meet job requirements and adapt to changes.
